replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. The abstract nature of advanced topics makes me feel overwhelmed. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't used AI for math learning yet. My high conscientiousness means I prefer structured, traditional study methods over experimental tools. I trust established textbooks and lectures more than untested digital assistants.
